question: What causal and nurturing nature does the speaker claim to possess always?
premises: The speaker has attained the state of cause
The speaker is always of the nature of the supporter
The speaker is always of the nature of the nurse
inference: The speaker claims to be always in the causal state, as both supporter and nurse
uncertainties: dhātu and dhātrī may carry layered meanings of element/supporter and nurse/creatrix
plain_english: Having attained the state of the cause, I am always of the nature of the supporter and of the nurse.
